hypothesis: In an intervention-limited, non-token physical causal world, action choices that explicitly discriminate top plausible compositional causal rules and archived context hypotheses yield higher unfamiliar-composition held-out accuracy and cold-retained return-context accuracy than an equally paid passive policy and matched conventional Bayesian active-information policy, without raising confidently wrong predictions or whole-process CPU.

physics.inherit: Exactly the SL09 4-bit, 4-action, 6 Boolean gate grammar and phase structure; source imports the frozen SL09 truth-table primitives and program grammar from the exact parent. Each action can only flip its own state bit when its hidden causal predicate is true.
physics.phase: A: steps 0–29, B: steps 30–59, then A/B/stationary A/unmodeled mixed composition for 60–79. Hidden generated programs use the same family-specific public seed construction as SL09 with newly disjoint seeds. Ten genuine charged exogenous perturbation flips at indices [6,14,22,30,38,46,54,62,70,78].
physics.action_policy: Step<60: fixed public causal action step%4 (except chargeable flips). Step>=60 and nonflip: policy may choose any 0..3 physically valid action before observing next state, charged once. A fresh world is physically stepped for every comparison arm; no evaluator truth, hidden program, seed, private phase, free reset, scripted post-observation action or imagined consequence is supplied to any learner or selector.
physics.audit: After steps 60,64,72,80 use uniform evaluator-only grid of 16 states × 4 actions; count correct, confidently wrong, abstentions and never-observed state/action pairs. No evaluator observation may update any learner.

arms: candidate_active: original unchanged SL09 compositional episodic learner with a novel disagreement/challenge action selector using top-six program witnesses from its own paid event bank(s).

bayes_on_candidate: independently implemented Bayesian full-grammar memory learner trained on a freshly paid exact physical replay of candidate_active's chosen actions. Same physical states/action identities/outcomes as candidate_active.
candidate_no_episodic_on_candidate: frozen SL09 no-episodic model on independently charged identical candidate_active trajectory, checks whether archive contributes.
bayes_active: independently implemented full-grammar Bayesian episodic control selecting paid action with maximum posterior predictive Bernoulli uncertainty.
candidate_on_bayes: frozen SL09 candidate learner trained from a freshly charged exact physical replay of bayes_active's chosen actions.
candidate_passive: unchanged SL09 compositional episodic learner with public postcold action step%4.
bayes_passive: Bayesian control freshly charged identical candidate_passive trajectory.
candidate_sham: same candidate learner but selects the smallest rule-disagreement score rather than most informative, with identical action count and tie logic.
bayes_on_sham: Bayesian control on freshly charged identical candidate_sham trajectory.
policy: Candidate action score: among top six minimum-empirical-counterexample action-conditioned programs of active bank, maximize prediction split n0*n1; add weighted disagreement between two archived bank predictions and small bonus for physically unobserved state/action; choose deterministically, tie-break by public step rotation. Sham minimizes the same score. Bayesian action score: maximize p(flip)*(1-p(flip)) under a fully enumerated 216-program likelihood posterior per action, evidence from its own paid observations, deterministic tie-break. No hidden/evaluator labels used.
model_control: New Bayesian control has an independently implemented posterior scorer, context banks and context switching; same publicly declared grammar and same actual paid physical histories within replay-paired arms. SL09 frozen candidate class is imported, no post-result modification to model source. Record epistemic limitation: active policies observe different physical traces despite equal paid counts; matched-trace paired learner comparisons are valid only within each replay group, whereas between active policies there is matched cost but not matched information.

budgets.actions_after_cold: 18 actual causal action choices (other two of 20 steps are charged flips)
budgets.all_comparison_groups: candidate_active paired with bayes_on_candidate and candidate_no_episodic_on_candidate; bayes_active paired with candidate_on_bayes; candidate_passive paired with bayes_passive; candidate_sham paired with bayes_on_sham. Require byte-identical per-world paid action/outcome traces within each pairing; all arms' first 60 physical steps identical. Different postcold policy traces are reported explicitly.

primary.hard_required: All 32 seeds and 9 arms complete, 23,040 charged real steps and 20,160 causal events, correct per-pair trajectory SHA-256 and full shared pre60 SHA-256, cold restore and integrity checked at step 60, <=8192 checkpoint, no hidden inputs or free auditor observations, negative tests, final exact SHA full regression and dual OS deterministic scientific receipt equality.
primary.classification: If all thresholds and hard requirements hold: DEV_SIGNAL_NOT_SCIENCE. If some gain but one fails: MIXED_DEV. Otherwise: NEGATIVE_DEV. Invalid on rule leakage, retrofitted threshold/seed/model changes after outcomes, charge mismatch, failed scientific provenance or missing cross-platform equivalence. Synthetic DEV never automatically implies SCIENTIFIC_PASS, AGI or native integration.

resource_accounting: Measure learner+policy decision and observation CPU ns separately from world/audits and from total process; verify cold checkpoint size and memory. Action policies have identical physical step counts but not identical information content or necessarily identical compute; record both. CPU runs on Ubuntu and Windows may differ, do not require identical timing.
qualification: Two operating systems, fixed Python 3.12, exact candidate source SHA; all focused/negative tests and mandatory inherited full regression; G29 code-atlas pinned candidate reanchor after generated index mismatch only (mechanical, no source/physics retune); record original per-world synthetic DEV outcomes and source custody in GitHub Actions. No post-result scientific retuning or seed recycling.
authority: External branch-only draft PR. No ref edits to main/accepted, native model, Forge/Yggdrasil owner/controller/research loop, first-use scientific lane, Wingless, Hybrid or weight-programming source. No scheduled tasks, live experiments, paid APIs, local workstation or ChatGPT Library evidence uploads.
limitations: Toy four-bit Boolean world, possible concentration of physical states and active-learning policy selection bias; finite family known to Bayesian comparator; neither tokenless AGI, broad causal transfer, independent replication nor numerical compute parity can be inferred from this synthetic test.
